title: samara myrtillus
intro: Samara myrtillus, commonly known as bilberry, is a type of shrub with edible fruits that belong to the heath family (Ericaceae). The bilberry plant is rich in health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been linked to reducing the risk of heart disease, diabetes, and certain cancers. The therapeutic actions of bilberry include improving vision, enhancing cognitive function, and supporting immune system health, largely due to its high content of anthocyanins and other bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of bilberry include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
